name: ai-mystery-room
description: AI Mystery Room — a fictional detective game with a deterministic sample case.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@amr/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@amr/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@amr/backend && npm run build --workspace=@amr/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@amr/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@amr/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=@amr/backend && npm run test --workspace=@amr/frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=@amr/backend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=@amr/frontend
